purpose: resolve and revalidate frozen P5 approvers without CUT reading PROJ or SYSTEM tables
trustedTenant: tenantId must equal TenantContextHolder.getRequiredTenantId before Owner calls

ProjectCutoverServiceManagerFactApi.deliveryUnit: F-CUT-005 PROJ physical-owner support Task; no separate Feature or table; Provider may reuse the existing ProjectParticipant aggregate and locking rules

inspectCurrent.output: FOUND|NOT_UNIQUE; FOUND carries exactly one current primary SERVICE_MANAGER_L1 or SERVICE_MANAGER_L2 user, projectVersion, participantFactVersion and roleCode

lockAndRevalidate.output: VALID|STALE; STALE carries current FOUND or NOT_UNIQUE result

inspectUnique.output: FOUND|NOT_UNIQUE; FOUND carries exactly one enabled adminUserId, roleGroupId, roleMembershipVersion and userStatusVersion

lockAndRevalidate.output: VALID|STALE; STALE carries current FOUND or NOT_UNIQUE result

lockExplicitCandidate.output: ELIGIBLE carrying roleGroupId, roleMembershipVersion and userStatusVersion | INELIGIBLE

CutoverApprovalRoleCandidateFactApi.projectScopeComposition: CUT additionally requires ProjectScopeApi ACTION_VIEW for the resolved subjectUserId and freezes the returned treeVersion; global role membership alone never grants project approval

routeMapping.INITIATOR: trusted current user from F-CUT-004 submit transaction

reassignmentRules.INITIATOR: explicit target must pass ProjectScopeApi ACTION_EDIT for the same project; nodeCode and original initiator history remain unchanged
reassignmentRules.SERVICE_MANAGER: explicit target must equal the current unique FOUND user from ProjectCutoverServiceManagerFactApi and its fact is locked again
reassignmentRules.SECOND_LINE_RND: explicit target must be ELIGIBLE from CutoverApprovalRoleCandidateFactApi.lockExplicitCandidate and pass ProjectScopeApi ACTION_VIEW

notUniqueRule: zero or multiple candidates create/retain the approval instance in PENDING with holdReason=ROUTE_CANDIDATE_NOT_UNIQUE and no executable todo for that node; no arbitrary candidate is selected
controlledSubstituteBoundary: src/test may deterministically return valid candidates and watermarks; no production Fake, fallback, direct table read or Yudao foundation modification is authorized
